sentences.zh: 科罗拉多州的格里利市是该州东部平原上的一座中型城市。

sentences.en: The landscape is simple and flat.

sentences.en: Cow pastures stretch as far as the eye can see.
sentences.zh: 牛群牧场一眼望不到边。

sentences.en: And most days, the breeze smells of manure.
sentences.zh: 大多数日子里，微风中都弥漫着粪便的味道。

sentences.en: When most Americans imagine a place like Greeley, they think of cowboys, farmers, political
sentences.zh: 当大多数美国人想象格里利这样的地方时，他们会想到牛仔、农民、政治

sentences.zh: 保守派，以及主要是白人。

sentences.zh: 那是我对格里利的刻板印象，至少在我作为农业记者在那里工作之前是这样。

sentences.zh: 穆罕默德只会说一点英语，所以我们请了一位翻译来沟通。

sentences.en: At an old Formica dinner table, Mohamed served me coffee.
sentences.zh: 在一张旧的福米卡餐桌旁，穆罕默德为我端上了咖啡。

sentences.zh: 他穿着笼基，这是他家乡缅甸的一种传统长裙。

sentences.en: And he told me what life was like there.
sentences.zh: 他向我讲述了那里的生活。

sentences.en: So he's talking about the pedi, the rice.
sentences.zh: 他在说“佩迪”，也就是稻米。

sentences.en: So he plowed the land, and then he pulled in the seedlings, then he transplants.
sentences.zh: 他耕地，然后拔秧，接着进行移栽。

sentences.en: Mohamed was a rice farmer.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德曾是一名稻农。

sentences.en: But then he faced persecution by the government and had to flee his country.
sentences.zh: 但后来他遭到了政府的迫害，不得不逃离自己的国家。

sentences.en: He was registered as a refugee by the UN.
sentences.zh: 他被联合国登记为难民。

sentences.en: And eventually, after undergoing a rigorous background check, he was one of the lucky ones selected
sentences.zh: 最终，在经历了严格的背景调查后，他成为了被选中进行

sentences.en: for resettlement.
sentences.zh: 重新安置的幸运儿之一。

sentences.en: I was always thinking how America would be and what I will do there.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想美国会是什么样子，我在那里能做什么。

sentences.en: And I was excited, especially...
sentences.zh: 我感到很兴奋，尤其是……

sentences.en: In 2015, Mohamed left the refugee camp where he'd been living and flew across the world,
sentences.zh: 2015年，穆罕默德离开了居住的难民营，飞越了半个地球，

sentences.en: ending up here, in Greeley.
sentences.zh: 最终来到了这里，格里利。

sentences.en: This would be his new home.
sentences.zh: 这将是他的新家。

sentences.en: So when I got in America, then my caseworker, within one month, I got the job in JBS.
sentences.zh: 我到美国后，我的个案管理员在一个月内就帮我在JBS找到了工作。

sentences.en: JBS.
sentences.zh: JBS。

sentences.en: The massive meatpacking plant in Greeley that we mentioned earlier.
sentences.zh: 就是我们之前提到的格里利那家大型肉类加工厂。

sentences.en: To get his job, Mohamed didn't have to speak English.
sentences.zh: 为了得到这份工作，穆罕默德不需要会说英语。

sentences.en: He didn't need any prior experience.
sentences.zh: 他也不需要任何相关经验。

sentences.en: The caseworker didn't even really explain what JBS was.
sentences.zh: 个案管理员甚至没有真正解释JBS是做什么的。

sentences.en: He only said, JBS, there's many different kind of job.
sentences.zh: 他只说：“JBS，那里有很多种不同的工作。”

sentences.en: Then you will do one of them.
sentences.zh: “然后你会做其中一种。”

sentences.en: He said, just like this.
sentences.zh: 他说，就是这样。

sentences.en: So he didn't tell him that it was a slaughterhouse or that he would be working with meat?
sentences.zh: 所以他没告诉他那是屠宰场，也没说他要处理肉类？

sentences.en: He didn't know that?
sentences.zh: 他不知道吗？

sentences.en: He didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 他不知道。

sentences.en: After his first week at JBS, Mohamed realized just what kind of work he'd be doing.
sentences.zh: 在JBS工作的第一周后，穆罕默德才意识到他到底在做什么样的工作。

sentences.en: He used a large electric knife to remove the skin from cow legs.
sentences.zh: 他用一把大型电动刀剥掉牛腿上的皮。

sentences.en: It was bloody, exhausting labor.
sentences.zh: 那是血腥且耗尽体力的劳动。

sentences.en: In most plants, workers assemble things, like cars.
sentences.zh: 在大多数工厂里，工人们组装东西，比如汽车。

sentences.en: But in a meatpacking plant, the workers disassemble animals.
sentences.zh: 但在肉类加工厂，工人们拆解动物。

sentences.en: They stand along conveyor belts where line speeds run incredibly faSt.
sentences.zh: 他们站在传送带旁，流水线的速度快得惊人。

sentences.en: Up to 450 cows are killed every hour.
sentences.zh: 每小时有多达450头牛被屠宰。

sentences.en: And the workers use wickedly sharp electric knives to break them down into cuts of meat, like chuck and rib.
sentences.zh: 工人们使用极其锋利的电动刀将它们分解成肉块，比如肩肉和肋排。

sentences.en: And as conveyor belts, meat grinders, and saws rumbled around Mohamed,
sentences.zh: 当传送带、绞肉机和锯子在穆罕默德周围轰鸣时，

sentences.en: he looked around the factory floor and noticed something else.
sentences.zh: 他环顾工厂车间，注意到了另一件事。

sentences.en: Many of the other workers were from places like Somalia, Eritrea, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
sentences.zh: 许多其他工人来自索马里、厄立特里亚和刚果民主共和国等地。

sentences.en: They all arrived here as refugees, like him.
sentences.zh: 他们都像他一样，作为难民来到这里。

sentences.en: I understand that people are getting their job as I did.
sentences.zh: 我明白大家都是像我一样得到这份工作的。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: There's a caseworker, caseworker, my brother.
sentences.zh: 有个案管理员，个案管理员，我的兄弟。

sentences.en: So he knew that everyone was getting the job the same way.
sentences.zh: 所以他知道每个人都是通过同样的方式得到这份工作的。

sentences.en: The same way, yeah.
sentences.zh: 同样的方式，是的。

sentences.en: The scale of meatpacking in this country is staggering.
sentences.zh: 这个国家肉类加工业的规模大得惊人。

sentences.en: Half a million people work in the industry, producing tens of billions of pounds of meat every year
sentences.zh: 有五十万人从事这个行业，每年生产数百亿磅的肉类，

sentences.en: and generating billions of dollars in profits.
sentences.zh: 并创造数十亿美元的利润。

sentences.en: Companies like JBS are among the largest employers in rural America.
sentences.zh: 像JBS这样的公司是美国农村地区最大的雇主之一。

sentences.en: But the industry doesn't just process animals.
sentences.zh: 但这个行业不仅仅是加工动物。

sentences.en: It churns through people.
sentences.zh: 它还在消耗人。

sentences.en: The work is so brutal and physically punishing that many don't last long on the job.
sentences.zh: 这项工作极其残酷且对身体伤害极大，以至于许多人干不长久。

sentences.en: Workers often suffer chronic injuries from the repetitive nature of the work.
sentences.zh: 工人经常因重复性的工作而患上慢性损伤。

sentences.en: They can also lose fingers, even whole appendages.
sentences.zh: 他们还可能失去手指，甚至整个肢体。

sentences.en: Research shows that there are about two amputations a week across the entire industry,
sentences.zh: 研究表明，整个行业平均每周发生约两起截肢事故，

sentences.en: which means that meatpacking companies are always searching for new bodies to run the line.
sentences.zh: 这意味着肉类加工公司一直在寻找新的劳动力来维持生产线。

sentences.en: But in the last 20 years, companies like JBS have come to rely on a new source of labor.
sentences.zh: 但在过去20年里，像JBS这样的公司开始依赖一种新的劳动力来源。

sentences.en: Refugees.
sentences.zh: 难民。

sentences.en: Arriving through humanitarian programs that are supposed to offer safety and a shot at the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他们通过人道主义项目来到这里，这些项目本应提供安全和实现美国梦的机会。

sentences.en: And it's through this particular arrangement that rural, Midwestern towns like Greeley
sentences.zh: 正是通过这种特殊的安排，像格里利这样的中西部农村城镇

sentences.en: have become home to thousands of people like Mohammed.
sentences.zh: 成为了成千上万像穆罕默德这样的人的家园。

sentences.en: Men and women who fled violence and persecution,
sentences.zh: 这些男人和女人逃离了暴力和迫害，

sentences.en: only to find themselves doing what has long been one of the most dangerous jobs in America.
sentences.zh: 却发现自己从事着美国长期以来最危险的工作之一。

sentences.en: In 1904, the journalist Upton Sinclair went undercover working in meatpacking plants in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 1904年，记者厄普顿·辛克莱潜入芝加哥的肉类加工厂工作。

sentences.en: Then he wrote a novel based on his experiences called The Jungle.
sentences.zh: 随后，他根据自己的经历写了一部名为《屠场》的小说。

sentences.en: He described poor, newly arrived immigrants, mostly from Eastern Europe,
sentences.zh: 他描述了贫穷、刚抵达的移民，大多来自东欧，

sentences.en: who worked in dangerous, squalid conditions.
sentences.zh: 他们在危险、肮脏的环境中工作。

sentences.en: These immigrants came to America chasing the promise of a better life.
sentences.zh: 这些移民来到美国是为了追求更美好生活的承诺。

sentences.en: Instead, they found themselves teetering on the edge of poverty and hunger
sentences.zh: 然而，他们发现自己徘徊在贫困和饥饿的边缘，

sentences.en: and facing working conditions even worse than today's.
sentences.zh: 面临的工作环境甚至比今天还要糟糕。

sentences.en: The work left their hands so mangled that their fingernails wore off,
sentences.zh: 工作使他们的双手伤痕累累，指甲脱落，

sentences.en: and they were exposed to deadly infections.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还暴露在致命的感染中。

sentences.en: They'd pour acid on sheep pelts and yank out the wool with their bare hands, scalding their skin.
sentences.zh: 他们会把酸液倒在羊皮上，用赤手拔掉羊毛，烫伤皮肤。

sentences.en: With the slip of a sharp knife, many workers had severed the tendons of their thumbs.
sentences.zh: 随着锋利刀具的滑落，许多工人切断了拇指的肌腱。

sentences.en: But it wasn't those brutal conditions that captured the public's outrage.
sentences.zh: 但引起公众愤怒的并不是这些残酷的条件。

sentences.en: As Sinclair later said,
sentences.zh: 正如辛克莱后来所说，

sentences.en: People cared less about exploited workers than about what was ending up on their plates.
sentences.zh: 人们对被剥削的工人并不关心，他们更关心的是餐桌上最终会出现什么。

sentences.en: Sinclair described poisoned rats ground into sausage,
sentences.zh: 辛克莱描述了被磨进香肠里的毒死的老鼠，

sentences.en: or how cows covered in oozing boils were butchered and made into canned meat.
sentences.zh: 或者长满脓包的牛是如何被屠宰并制成罐头肉的。

sentences.en: Those were the images people couldn't forget.
sentences.zh: 那些是人们无法忘记的画面。

sentences.en: Even if Sinclair's book didn't do exactly what he wanted it to, it was still influential.
sentences.zh: 即使辛克莱的书没有完全达到他想要的效果，它仍然具有影响力。

sentences.en: Federal laws were enacted to enforce inspections and sanitation.
sentences.zh: 联邦法律得以颁布，以强制执行检查和卫生标准。

sentences.en: But in the 1940s, it seemed like things were finally going to change for the workers.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪40年代，工人们的情况似乎终于要好转了。

sentences.en: A boom in the post-war economy meant that people were eating more meat,
sentences.zh: 战后经济的繁荣意味着人们吃更多的肉，

sentences.en: which in turn increased the hiring at meatpacking plants.
sentences.zh: 这反过来增加了肉类加工厂的招聘需求。

sentences.en: Workers' jobs became skilled labor and were unionized.
sentences.zh: 工人的工作变成了技术劳动，并加入了工会。

sentences.en: For the first time, their positions were salaried.
sentences.zh: 他们第一次有了固定薪水。

sentences.en: Meatpackers could finally afford a middle-class lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 肉类加工工人终于负担得起中产阶级的生活方式。

sentences.en: They had boats in their driveways and pools in their backyards.
sentences.zh: 他们的车道上有船，后院里有游泳池。

sentences.en: But the relief was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但这种解脱是短暂的。

sentences.en: Because meatpacking companies made a decision that would transform the entire workforce
sentences.zh: 因为肉类加工公司做出了一个决定，这个决定将改变整个劳动力结构，

sentences.en: and add a whole new layer of vulnerability in an already dangerous industry.
sentences.zh: 并在一个本已危险的行业中增加了一层全新的脆弱性。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, meatpacking companies left the cities where they'd been based for decades
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，肉类加工公司离开了它们扎根几十年的城市，

sentences.en: and moved their plants to rural America.
sentences.zh: 将工厂搬到了美国农村。

sentences.en: The shift put them closer to livestock and cut down on transportation costs.
sentences.zh: 这一转变使它们更接近牲畜，并降低了运输成本。

sentences.en: Critically, it also let them escape the unions in the cities
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，这也让它们摆脱了城市的工会，

sentences.en: and the prying eyes of pesky reporters and politicians.
sentences.zh: 以及讨厌的记者和政客的窥探。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: The rural communities that they relocated to did not have sufficient labor for them.
sentences.zh: 它们搬迁到的农村社区没有足够的劳动力供它们使用。

sentences.en: This is Don Stoll, a professor emeritus of anthropology at the University of Kansas.
sentences.zh: 这位是堪萨斯大学人类学名誉教授唐·斯托尔。

sentences.en: He told me that without the unions, the working conditions and pay inside the plants declined
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，没有了工会，工厂内部的工作条件和工资再次下降。

sentences.en: once again.
sentences.zh: 为了吸引所需的工人，公司将目光投向了南方的墨西哥。

sentences.en: And to attract the workers they needed, companies looked south to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 嗯，肉类加工公司一直都在南德克萨斯州和其他地方的广播电台做广告，

sentences.en: Well, meatpacking companies had always advertised on radio stations in South Texas and elsewhere,
sentences.zh: 这些广播覆盖到墨西哥，宣传肉类加工厂有工作机会。

sentences.en: which broadcast into Mexico, that there were jobs available in meatpacking plants.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪80年代，在移民局的默许下，

sentences.en: But in the 1980s, with the blessing of the INS,
sentences.zh: 它们实际上在墨西哥城设立了招聘站。

sentences.en: they were actually set up recruiting stations in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 尽管肉类加工业名声不佳，但这些拉美工人被吸引到这里的原因有很多。

sentences.en: There were many reasons that these Latin American workers were drawn to meatpacking,
sentences.zh: 移民被肉类加工业吸引的原因之一是，

sentences.en: despite its gruesome reputation.
sentences.zh: 在肉类加工厂工作不需要会说英语。

sentences.en: One of the attractions of meatpacking for immigrants
sentences.zh: 而且不需要任何预先的工作技能。

sentences.en: is that you don't have to speak English to work in a meatpacking plant.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪60年代，格里利正成为肉类加工业的领头羊。

sentences.en: And you don't have to have any pre-existing job skills.
sentences.zh: 它是最早建立大型现代化包装厂的小城镇之一。

sentences.en: By the 1960s, Greeley was becoming a leader in meatpacking.
sentences.zh: 来自四面八方的牧场主都来到这里收获他们的牛群。

sentences.en: It was one of the first small towns to build a big, modern packing plant.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的墨西哥移民充实了工厂的员工队伍。

sentences.en: And ranchers from all around came there to harvest their cattle.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人以前在附近的农业部门工作。

sentences.en: Increasingly, Mexican immigrants staffed the factory.
sentences.zh: 但这些包装工作是在室内，免受烈日暴晒，

sentences.en: Many of them had previously worked in nearby agriculture.
sentences.zh: 而且工资比田间劳动更高。

sentences.en: But these packing jobs were inside, shielded from the hot sun,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代和90年代，新一波工人来到格里利，

sentences.en: and they paid better than fieldwork.
sentences.zh: 不仅来自墨西哥，还来自中美洲的其他地区。

sentences.en: In the 1980s and 90s, new waves of workers arrived in Greeley,
sentences.zh: 他们搬进了包装厂周围的社区，

sentences.en: not just from Mexico, but other parts of Central America.
sentences.zh: 当时那家工厂被称为斯威夫特公司。

sentences.en: They moved into the neighborhoods around the packing plant,
sentences.zh: 到21世纪初，格里利约三分之一的人口是拉丁裔。

sentences.en: which was now called Swifting Company.
sentences.zh: 你随处可见。

sentences.en: By the early 2000s, about one-third of Greeley's population was Latino.
sentences.zh: 当地的杂货店开始出售新鲜的玉米饼。

sentences.en: You could see it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你随处可见。

sentences.en: The local grocery stores started selling fresh tortillas
sentences.zh: 当地的杂货店开始出售新鲜的玉米饼。

sentences.en: and dried chiles imported from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 以及从墨西哥进口的干辣椒。

sentences.en: The schools created ESL courses.
sentences.zh: 学校开设了英语作为第二语言（ESL）的课程。

sentences.en: But the change also brought backlash.
sentences.zh: 但这种变化也带来了反弹。

sentences.en: The city was starkly divided along racial lines.
sentences.zh: 这座城市在种族界线上泾渭分明。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, in the background, another labor problem was brewing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在幕后，另一个劳动力问题正在酝酿。

sentences.en: It was an open secret that hundreds of workers at the plant were undocumented.
sentences.zh: 工厂里有数百名无证工人在当时已是公开的秘密。

sentences.en: The meatpacking company reviewed their workers' documentation
sentences.zh: 肉类加工公司审查了工人的证件，

sentences.en: with a federal system called E-Verify,
sentences.zh: 使用的是一套名为“电子验证”（E-Verify）的联邦系统，

sentences.en: which was known to be deeply flawed.
sentences.zh: 而该系统被公认为存在严重缺陷。

sentences.en: And on the morning of December 12, 2006,
sentences.zh: 2006年12月12日的早晨，

sentences.en: the situation reached a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 局势到了爆发的临界点。

sentences.en: Greeley's meatpackers started the day like most other days.
sentences.zh: 格里利的肉类加工工人们像往常一样开始了新的一天。

sentences.en: The first shift arrived at the factory before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 第一班工人日出前就抵达了工厂。

sentences.en: They put on their hard hats and white smocks
sentences.zh: 他们戴上安全帽，穿上白大褂，

sentences.en: and took their positions along the massive conveyor belt,
sentences.zh: 在巨大的传送带旁各就各位，

sentences.en: ready for the first slaughter of the day.
sentences.zh: 准备迎接当天的第一批屠宰工作。

sentences.en: But then, just before the giant factory rumbled to life,
sentences.zh: 但就在巨大的工厂轰鸣运转之前，

sentences.en: all hell broke loose.
sentences.zh: 一切都乱套了。

sentences.en: Just after dawn, federal agents from ICE, Immigration and Customs Enforcement,
sentences.zh: 黎明刚过，来自美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）的联邦特工，

sentences.en: descended on plants run by Swifton Company,
sentences.zh: 突袭了由斯威夫特公司（Swift Company）运营的工厂，

sentences.en: the nation's third-largest meatpacker.
sentences.zh: 这是全美第三大肉类加工商。

sentences.en: It's the largest ever crackdown on illegal immigration in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 这是有史以来针对职场非法移民最大规模的打击行动。

sentences.en: 1,200 arrests now reported across six states.
sentences.zh: 目前已有六个州报告了1200人被捕。

sentences.en: Shortly after 7 a.m., agents from Immigration and Customs Enforcement
sentences.zh: 早上7点刚过，来自移民及海关执法局的特工们

sentences.en: charged inside and swarmed the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 冲进工厂，蜂拥至生产车间。

sentences.en: People ran like mad.
sentences.zh: 人们疯狂地奔逃。

sentences.en: Some tried to hide in the cattle pens or inside the bathrooms or supply closets.
sentences.zh: 有些人试图躲进牛栏、厕所或储物间里。

sentences.en: But in the end, hundreds were rounded up and arrested.
sentences.zh: 但最终，数百人还是被围捕并逮捕了。

sentences.en: Several hundred family members gathered along the fence
sentences.zh: 数百名家属聚集在围栏边，

sentences.en: between the Swift Company and Highway 85.
sentences.zh: 就在斯威夫特公司和85号公路之间。

sentences.en: Some were crying.
sentences.zh: 有人在哭泣。

sentences.en: Some were praying.
sentences.zh: 有人在祈祷。

sentences.en: Others were yelling at the federal agents.
sentences.zh: 还有人对着联邦特工大喊大叫。

sentences.en: Similar scenes played out in six different meatpacking plants across Middle America,
sentences.zh: 类似的场景在全美腹地的六家不同肉类加工厂同时上演，

sentences.en: at the same time, on the same day.
sentences.zh: 在同一天，同一时间。

sentences.en: ICE agents arrested close to 1,300 workers for having, quote,
sentences.zh: ICE特工逮捕了近1300名工人，理由是他们持有，引用，

sentences.en: quote, questionable documentation.
sentences.zh: 引用，“有问题的证件”。

sentences.en: Overnight, Swift lost about 10% of its workforce.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，斯威夫特公司失去了约10%的劳动力。

sentences.en: Without enough people, some factories couldn't operate,
sentences.zh: 由于人手不足，一些工厂无法运作，

sentences.en: and the company was hemorrhaging money.
sentences.zh: 公司损失惨重。

sentences.en: It was a crisis of epic proportions, and it raised the same old question.
sentences.zh: 这是一场史无前例的危机，它引出了那个老生常谈的问题。

sentences.en: Where on earth would Swift find more people willing to perform this dangerous work?
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特到底去哪儿找更多愿意从事这种危险工作的人呢？

sentences.en: This time, Swift found its answer in an unlikely place.
sentences.zh: 这一次，斯威夫特在一个意想不到的地方找到了答案。

sentences.en: A federal program meant to help people fleeing war and persecution.
sentences.zh: 一个旨在帮助逃离战争和迫害的人们的联邦项目。

sentences.en: That's when we return.
sentences.zh: 稍后我们回来继续讲述。

sentences.en: Before the raids in 2006,
sentences.zh: 在2006年的突袭之前，

sentences.en: Swift and Company was already limping along financially.
sentences.zh: 斯威夫特公司在财务上就已经举步维艰。

sentences.en: For years, they'd struggled to make a profit,
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们一直难以盈利，

sentences.en: and it only got worse when they lost a large fraction of their workforce.
sentences.zh: 而在失去大部分劳动力后，情况变得更糟了。

sentences.en: Five months after the raids,
sentences.zh: 突袭发生五个月后，

sentences.en: it was announced the company was being sold to JBS,
sentences.zh: 公司宣布被出售给JBS，

sentences.en: the Brazilian-owned meatpacker.
sentences.zh: 一家巴西拥有的肉类加工商。

sentences.en: The new owners got busy trying to solve the labor problem.
sentences.zh: 新东家开始忙着解决劳动力问题。

sentences.en: One news article from that time reported how company officials met in a war room
sentences.zh: 当时的一篇新闻报道称，公司高管们在一个作战室里开会，

sentences.en: with maps pinned to the walls.
sentences.zh: 墙上贴满了地图。

sentences.en: They marked the cities and towns outside their meatpacking plants
sentences.zh: 他们将肉类加工厂周边的城市和城镇标记出来，

sentences.en: as potential recruitment zones.
sentences.zh: 作为潜在的招聘区域。

sentences.en: They advertised the open positions on the radio, newspapers, and billboards.
sentences.zh: 他们在广播、报纸和广告牌上发布招聘信息。

sentences.en: But not many people wanted to sign up.
sentences.zh: 但没多少人愿意报名。

sentences.en: And so, to dig themselves out of this labor shortage,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了摆脱这种劳动力短缺的困境，

sentences.en: JBS adopted a new strategy.
sentences.zh: JBS采取了一项新策略。

sentences.en: The company set its sights on a new population.
sentences.zh: 公司将目光投向了一个新群体。

sentences.en: Like the undocumented workers before them,
sentences.zh: 就像之前的无证工人一样，

sentences.en: these workers didn't speak much English.
sentences.zh: 这些工人不太会说英语。

sentences.en: They were eager to find jobs and willing to do hard labor that many others refused.
sentences.zh: 他们渴望找到工作，并愿意从事许多人拒绝的艰苦劳动。

sentences.en: And crucially, they were in the country legally.
sentences.zh: 而且至关重要的是，他们是合法入境的。

sentences.en: JBS turned to refugees.
sentences.zh: JBS转向了难民群体。

sentences.en: An aggressive recruitment campaign began.
sentences.zh: 一场激进的招聘运动开始了。

sentences.en: Company representatives went to Denver
sentences.zh: 公司代表前往丹佛，

sentences.en: and staked out East African restaurants and mosques.
sentences.zh: 蹲守在东非餐馆和清真寺附近。

sentences.en: They offered new hires a cash bonus of up to $1,500 and more for referrals.
sentences.zh: 他们为新员工提供高达1500美元的现金奖励，推荐他人入职还有更多奖励。

sentences.en: And they used these same tactics across the heartland,
sentences.zh: 他们在整个美国腹地采取了同样的策略，

sentences.en: convincing refugees to move away from the cities
sentences.zh: 说服难民搬离那些他们原本可以获得

sentences.en: where they had access to federally funded support services.
sentences.zh: 联邦资助支持服务的城市。

sentences.en: They chartered buses and drove hundreds of refugees
sentences.zh: 他们包下大巴，将数百名难民运送到

sentences.en: to isolated meatpacking towns like Cactus, Texas,
sentences.zh: 像德克萨斯州仙人掌镇（Cactus）、

sentences.en: Grand Island, Nebraska, and Greeley, Colorado.
sentences.zh: 内布拉斯加州格兰德岛（Grand Island）和科罗拉多州格里利（Greeley）这样偏远的肉类加工城镇。

sentences.en: At the time of the SWIFT raids, right, everything changed in 2006.
sentences.zh: 在斯威夫特突袭事件发生时，对吧，2006年一切都变了。

sentences.en: Paul Stein was Colorado's refugee coordinator at the time,
sentences.zh: 保罗·斯坦（Paul Stein）当时是科罗拉多州的难民协调员，

sentences.en: the most senior person at the state level.
sentences.zh: 是州一级职位最高的人。

sentences.en: And he started to notice more and more refugees moving to Greeley.
sentences.zh: 他开始注意到越来越多的难民搬到格里利。

sentences.en: They were recruited by SWIFT, vigorously recruited.
sentences.zh: 他们是被斯威夫特招募来的，被大力招募。

sentences.en: You had a lot of, at that point, primarily Somalis, some Burmese,
sentences.zh: 当时你有很多主要是索马里人，还有一些缅甸人，

sentences.en: who moved in to take advantage of the employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 他们搬过来是为了利用这些就业机会。

sentences.en: And then those refugees would petition and bring their families.
sentences.zh: 然后这些难民会申请将他们的家人接过来。

sentences.en: According to Stein, as well as several other people I interviewed for the story,
sentences.zh: 据斯坦以及我为这个故事采访的其他几个人说，

sentences.en: the number of refugees living in Greeley ballooned overnight.
sentences.zh: 居住在格里利的难民人数一夜之间激增。

sentences.en: This is a story of backing into a plan rather than having the plan.
sentences.zh: 这是一个先行动后规划的故事，而不是先有规划再行动。

sentences.en: It totally started because of meatpacking.
sentences.zh: 这完全是因为肉类加工业才开始的。

sentences.en: But when refugees landed in Greeley, they struggled with everything.
sentences.zh: 但当难民们来到格里利时，他们在各方面都遇到了困难。

sentences.en: Most of the services Greeley had developed over the years were tailored to Spanish speakers,
sentences.zh: 格里利多年来发展的大多数服务都是为讲西班牙语的人量身定制的，

sentences.en: not speakers of Rohingya, Somali, or Tigray.
sentences.zh: 而不是为讲罗兴亚语、索马里语或提格雷语的人准备的。

sentences.en: Housing was hard to find.
sentences.zh: 住房很难找。

sentences.en: And without translation services,
sentences.zh: 而且由于缺乏翻译服务，

sentences.en: families struggled to enroll their kids in school or see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 家庭在给孩子报名上学或看医生时都很吃力。

sentences.en: Soon, an office for refugee resettlement opened up.
sentences.zh: 不久，一个难民安置办公室成立了。

sentences.en: We started with a very limited presence.
sentences.zh: 我们刚开始时规模非常有限。

sentences.en: I think we had a mighty team of one, one case manager,
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时有一个强大的“一人团队”，一名个案经理，

sentences.en: who for a time actually worked out of his vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他有一段时间甚至是在自己的车里办公的。

sentences.en: This is James Horan, the president and CEO of Lutheran Family Services Rocky Mountains,
sentences.zh: 这是詹姆斯·霍兰（James Horan），路德会家庭服务中心落基山分部（Lutheran Family Services Rocky Mountains）的总裁兼首席执行官，

sentences.en: which ran the office.
sentences.zh: 该机构负责运营这个办公室。

sentences.en: I think, you know, there really wasn't an infrastructure
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，除了讲西班牙语的新移民外，

sentences.en: for other than Spanish-speaking newcomers, right?
sentences.zh: 真的没有其他基础设施，对吧？

sentences.en: And so I think a lot of it was just as simple as making the adjustment
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多事情就像适应新语言、新文化，

sentences.en: of new languages, new cultures, and everything that came along with that.
sentences.zh: 以及随之而来的一切那样简单。

sentences.en: Gradually, you could see another wave of change washing over Greeley.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，你可以看到另一波变革浪潮席卷了格里利。

sentences.en: Once again, driven by the meatpacking plan.
sentences.zh: 再一次，是由肉类加工厂推动的。

sentences.en: For decades, the town had been mostly white.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这个城镇主要是白人。

sentences.en: Then it became white and Latino.
sentences.zh: 后来变成了白人和拉丁裔。

sentences.en: Now, it was increasingly international.
sentences.zh: 现在，它变得越来越国际化了。

sentences.en: On the main boulevard, there was the Mexican grocery store,
sentences.zh: 在主干道上，有一家墨西哥杂货店，

sentences.en: but you might also see women walking by in a bayas.
sentences.zh: 但你可能也会看到穿着长袍（abaya）走过的女性。

sentences.en: Eventually, a halal market and an East African restaurant opened up downtown.
sentences.zh: 最终，市中心开了一家清真市场和一家东非餐馆。

sentences.en: And the population of refugees continued to grow.
sentences.zh: 难民人口持续增长。

sentences.en: Not long after JBS bought Swift, they announced a second shift,
sentences.zh: 在JBS收购斯威夫特后不久，他们宣布增加第二个轮班，

sentences.en: meaning the plant would operate more than 18 hours a day,
sentences.zh: 这意味着工厂每天的运营时间将超过18小时，

sentences.en: and they'd have to double their workforce.
sentences.zh: 他们必须将劳动力增加一倍。

sentences.en: Lucky for JBS, America's refugee resettlement program became a steady source of workers.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，美国的难民安置项目成了JBS稳定的工人来源。

sentences.en: When I first noticed how this had happened, I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次注意到这一切是如何发生的时候，我感到震惊。

sentences.en: A program meant to be humanitarian in practice was pushing people into some of the hardest,
sentences.zh: 一个本应是人道主义的项目，实际上却把人们推向了国内最艰苦、

sentences.en: most dangerous jobs in the country.
sentences.zh: 最危险的工作岗位。

sentences.en: But as I dug deeper, I learned this wasn't part of a grand, malicious scheme.
sentences.zh: 但随着深入挖掘，我了解到这并非什么宏大的恶意阴谋。

sentences.en: The meatpacking companies were just taking advantage of America's flawed resettlement system
sentences.zh: 肉类加工公司只是在利用美国有缺陷的安置系统，

sentences.en: and how it was designed to work.
sentences.zh: 以及它被设计运作的方式。

sentences.en: America's current refugee system first emerged in the aftermath of the Vietnam War
sentences.zh: 美国目前的难民系统最早出现在越南战争之后，

sentences.en: with the Refugee Act of 1980.
sentences.zh: 即1980年的《难民法案》。

sentences.en: It increased the number of refugees admitted each year into the country.
sentences.zh: 它增加了每年获准进入美国的难民人数。

sentences.en: And for the first time, it created a standardized resettlement process
sentences.zh: 并且首次创建了一个由联邦政府监督的、

sentences.en: overseen by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 标准化的安置流程。

sentences.en: The new system helped to resettle the hundreds of thousands of refugees
sentences.zh: 新系统帮助安置了数十万名

sentences.en: arriving from Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia.
sentences.zh: 从越南、老挝和柬埔寨抵达的难民。

sentences.en: Asian refugees, they could be called the new settlers of the United States
sentences.zh: 亚洲难民，他们可以被称为美国的新定居者，

sentences.en: and they come to America's shores out of desperation, sadness, violence,
sentences.zh: 他们出于绝望、悲伤、暴力和被剥夺感，

sentences.en: and deprivation from their own battered homeland.
sentences.zh: 从他们自己满目疮痍的家园来到美国的海岸。

sentences.en: Many have escaped by small boats from the new communist governments.
sentences.zh: 许多人乘小船逃离了新的共产主义政权。

sentences.en: Often they've braved dangerous seas in small boats,
sentences.zh: 他们常常冒着危险，乘坐小船穿越波涛汹涌的大海，

sentences.en: attacks by pirates, and months of overcrowded conditions in refugee camps.
sentences.zh: 躲避海盗袭击，并在难民营中忍受了数月拥挤不堪的生活。

sentences.en: The resettlement program was well-intentioned,
sentences.zh: 安置项目初衷是好的，

sentences.en: a way to welcome people and offer them a shot at the American dream.
sentences.zh: 旨在欢迎人们并给他们一个实现美国梦的机会。

sentences.en: But it carried a built-in flaw, rooted in another American impulse.
sentences.zh: 但它带有一个内在缺陷，根植于另一种美国冲动。

sentences.en: We wanted them to lift themselves up by their bootstraps.
sentences.zh: 我们希望他们能靠自己的力量白手起家。

sentences.en: That's why the very first priority of the 1980s Refugee Act
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么1980年《难民法案》的首要任务

sentences.en: was economic self-sufficiency.
sentences.zh: 是经济上的自给自足。

sentences.en: Refugees were expected to find work
sentences.zh: 难民被期望尽快找到工作，

sentences.en: and get off government support as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 并摆脱政府的救济。

sentences.en: Job counseling is a key part of the orientation effort.
sentences.zh: 就业咨询是入职指导工作的关键部分。

sentences.en: Job skills previously learned are sometimes adaptable.
sentences.zh: 以前学到的职业技能有时是可以转用的。

sentences.en: In other cases, however, entirely new jobs must be learned
sentences.zh: 然而在其他情况下，必须学习全新的工作，

sentences.en: and training programs must be set up.
sentences.zh: 并且必须建立培训项目。

sentences.en: In the 45 years since the passage of the Refugee Act,
sentences.zh: 在《难民法案》通过后的45年里，

sentences.en: making it to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 成功抵达美国

sentences.en: as a refugee has become a significant feat.
sentences.zh: 作为难民是一项了不起的成就。

sentences.en: To start, you have to undergo several interviews
sentences.zh: 首先，你必须接受多次面试，

sentences.en: with international and U.S.
sentences.zh: 面对国际机构和美国机构的评估，

sentences.en: agencies who decide if you qualify.
sentences.zh: 由他们来决定你是否符合资格。

sentences.en: They ask a series of questions,
sentences.zh: 他们会问一系列问题，

sentences.en: like, are you fleeing political persecution?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是否在逃避政治迫害？

sentences.en: Will you be killed if you return home?
sentences.zh: 如果你回国，会被杀害吗？

sentences.en: If the answer is yes, and you can prove it,
sentences.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，而且你能证明这一点，

sentences.en: then the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国政府

sentences.en: government subjects you to a series of rigorous background checks
sentences.zh: 会对你进行一系列严格的背景调查

sentences.en: and medical screenings.
sentences.zh: 和体检。

sentences.en: The process takes up to two years.
sentences.zh: 整个过程最多需要两年时间。

sentences.en: If you're approved and you already have family in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 如果你获批，且在美国已经有亲人，

sentences.en: you'll be sent to live near them.
sentences.zh: 你会被送到他们附近居住。

sentences.en: Historically, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，美国

sentences.en: has accepted more refugees than any other nation.
sentences.zh: 接收的难民比其他任何国家都多。

sentences.en: But once people get here, we offer them little support.
sentences.zh: 但人们一旦到了这里，我们提供的支持却很少。

sentences.en: Places like Canada give newly arrived refugees
sentences.zh: 像加拿大这样的国家，会为刚抵达的难民

sentences.en: up to a year of services and financial assistance.
sentences.zh: 提供长达一年的服务和经济援助。

sentences.en: But the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国

sentences.en: gives people just three months.
sentences.zh: 只给人们三个月的时间。

sentences.en: And then they're on their own.
sentences.zh: 之后他们就得自谋生路了。

sentences.en: When a refugee arrives in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当难民抵达美国

sentences.en: to a place like Greeley,
sentences.zh: 来到格里利这样的地方时，

sentences.en: one of the first things that happens is that they're assigned a caseworker
sentences.zh: 首先发生的事情之一就是他们会被指派一名个案管理员，

sentences.en: who teaches them the basics of life in America,
sentences.zh: 教他们在美国生活的基本常识，

sentences.en: like how to find an apartment,
sentences.zh: 比如如何找公寓，

sentences.en: how to take the bus and buy groceries,
sentences.zh: 如何乘公交车和买菜，

sentences.en: and how to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 以及如何看医生。

sentences.en: But the most critical thing a newly arrived refugee needs to learn
sentences.zh: 但刚抵达的难民最需要学习的关键事情

sentences.en: is how to get a job.
sentences.zh: 是如何找工作。

sentences.en: I started as just what's called a job developer.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始的工作就是所谓的就业开发员。

sentences.en: Back in 2008, early on in his career,
sentences.zh: 回到2008年，在他职业生涯的早期，

sentences.en: John Tabor worked at a refugee resettlement agency in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 约翰·塔博尔在伊利诺伊州的一家难民安置机构工作。

sentences.en: I found John through a researcher on refugee resettlement
sentences.zh: 我是通过一位难民安置研究员找到约翰的，

sentences.en: who worked with him at that same organization.
sentences.zh: 他曾与约翰在同一家机构共事。

sentences.en: They both thought they'd be helping refugees,
sentences.zh: 他们两人都以为自己是在帮助难民，

sentences.en: but soon learned that wasn't necessarily true.
sentences.zh: 但很快发现事实并非一定如此。

sentences.en: In fact, years later, when I spoke with John over the phone,
sentences.zh: 事实上，多年后，当我通过电话与约翰交谈时，

sentences.en: he felt a lot of remorse,
sentences.zh: 他感到非常内疚，

sentences.en: which is why he was so honest and candid with me
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他对我如此诚实和坦率，

sentences.en: about what his work was actually like.
sentences.zh: 讲述了他工作的真实情况。

sentences.en: There is only a very, very small amount of resettlement money
sentences.zh: 这些家庭获得的安置资金

sentences.en: that these families are allocated.
sentences.zh: 真的非常、非常少。

sentences.en: You know, if they don't get a job pretty much immediately,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果他们不能几乎立即找到工作，

sentences.en: they're unable to pay their bills.
sentences.zh: 他们就付不起账单。

sentences.en: So, you know, within a few months,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，几个月内，

sentences.en: they'd be facing homelessness.
sentences.zh: 他们就会面临无家可归的境地。

sentences.en: You know, like literally, welcome to America.
sentences.zh: 你知道，简直就是，欢迎来到美国。

sentences.en: Now you're going to be evicted.
sentences.zh: 现在你要被驱逐了。

sentences.en: At his job, John was up against the same clock
sentences.zh: 在工作中，约翰面临着和

sentences.en: as the refugees he was helping.
sentences.zh: 他所帮助的难民同样的期限压力。

sentences.en: He had to get everyone gainfully employed
sentences.zh: 他必须让每个人都能获得报酬丰厚的工作，

sentences.en: before their three-month safety net ran out.
sentences.zh: 赶在他们三个月的安全网用完之前。

sentences.en: And he might have a caseload of 50 to 60 people.
sentences.zh: 他可能要负责50到60个人的个案。

sentences.en: You know, did a little bit of sort of skill development,
sentences.zh: 你知道，做了一点点技能开发，

sentences.en: but frankly, we didn't really have a lot of time for that.
sentences.zh: 但坦白说，我们真的没有太多时间做那个。

sentences.en: It was mostly get their resume together,
sentences.zh: 大部分时间都是帮他们整理简历，

sentences.en: try to figure out what they did in the past,
sentences.zh: 试着弄清楚他们过去做过什么，

sentences.en: and get them into work as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 并尽快让他们投入工作。

sentences.en: But it was rarely that straightforward.
sentences.zh: 但这很少有那么顺利。

sentences.en: We're talking about some of the most vulnerable people on the planet.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是地球上最弱势的一些群体。

sentences.en: Many didn't have any skills that would translate
sentences.zh: 许多人没有任何技能可以转化为

sentences.en: to the modern American job context.
sentences.zh: 现代美国的工作环境。

sentences.en: Some had lived in refugee camps for their entire lives.
sentences.zh: 有些人一生都住在难民营里。

sentences.en: They didn't have any work experience.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何工作经验。

sentences.en: You know, you couldn't put like sitting around the refugee camp,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不能写上“在难民营里坐着”，

sentences.en: or you couldn't put like tilling the field, you know.
sentences.zh: 或者你不能写上“耕地”，你知道。

sentences.en: It just wouldn't translate.
sentences.zh: 这根本转化不了。

sentences.en: And so John and his fellow job developers
sentences.zh: 所以约翰和他的同事们

sentences.en: connected the refugees with whatever employment options they could find.
sentences.zh: 尽其所能为难民联系就业机会。

sentences.en: It's not like they were applying to some high-level management position.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他们在申请什么高级管理职位。

sentences.en: They were at entry-level meatpacking jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们做的是入门级的肉类加工工作。

sentences.en: Meatpacking.
sentences.zh: 肉类加工。

sentences.en: Remember Mohammed, the Burmese refugee from the beginning of the story?
sentences.zh: 还记得故事开头提到的缅甸难民穆罕默德吗？

sentences.en: This is exactly how he got his job.
sentences.zh: 这就是他找到工作的方式。

sentences.en: A caseworker referred him to JBS.
sentences.zh: 个案管理员把他推荐给了JBS公司。

sentences.en: John remembers it was one of the most reliable choices
sentences.zh: 约翰记得这是最可靠的选择之一，

sentences.en: because meatpacking plants were always hiring,
sentences.zh: 因为肉类加工厂总是在招人，

sentences.en: and they paid better than most of the other options.
sentences.zh: 而且工资比其他大多数选择都要好。

sentences.en: With the high rates of injury and turnover,
sentences.zh: 由于伤病率和人员流动率很高，

sentences.en: plants were constantly looking for new workers,
sentences.zh: 工厂一直在寻找新工人，

sentences.en: and the jobs didn't require any English or previous experience.
sentences.zh: 而且这些工作不需要任何英语基础或过往经验。

sentences.en: There's one company, Tyson Foods.
sentences.zh: 有一家公司叫泰森食品。

sentences.en: Like JBS, Tyson is also a massive American meatpacking company.
sentences.zh: 和JBS一样，泰森也是一家大型美国肉类加工公司。

sentences.en: Tyson would announce like eight positions or nine positions,
sentences.zh: 泰森会宣布有八九个职位空缺，

sentences.en: and you'd get, you know, we would all show up with our refugees.
sentences.zh: 然后你会得到，你知道，我们都会带着我们的难民出现。

sentences.en: And it was a very, very well-established theater.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常、非常成熟的表演场。

sentences.en: It wasn't a humanitarian project for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这并不是一个人道主义项目。

sentences.en: It was, here's a group of workers that'll be efficient and effective
sentences.zh: 而是，这里有一群高效、能干的工人，

sentences.en: and, you know, will work faster and better than your American employees.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们会比你们的美国员工干得更快、更好。

sentences.en: And so that was the kind of relationships that we would form.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们建立的那种关系。

sentences.en: So, like, we were selling a product, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们其实是在推销一种产品。

sentences.en: And as time went on,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: John noticed that the recruiters he was in touch with at Tyson
sentences.zh: 约翰注意到他在泰森联系的招聘人员

sentences.en: became more specific about what type of worker they wanted.
sentences.zh: 对他们想要的工人类型变得更加具体。

sentences.en: Not so subtly would say, you know, we give us Burmese.
sentences.zh: 他们会毫不掩饰地说，你知道，给我们缅甸人。

sentences.en: You know, they were just sort of, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们只是，你知道，

sentences.en: these workers have worked out in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这些工人在过去表现得很好。

sentences.en: And there was this sort of tacit understanding
sentences.zh: 而且有一种默契，

sentences.en: was we should deliver them these workers.
sentences.zh: 就是我们应该给他们提供这些工人。

sentences.en: Like, if we showed up with five or six,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我们带了五六个，

sentences.en: I'm just saying, like, Iraqis, let's say.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，比如伊拉克人。

sentences.en: Because, you know, Iraqis had personalities, you know, big personalities.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，伊拉克人有个性，你知道，个性很强。

sentences.en: They came from a different culture.
sentences.zh: 他们来自不同的文化。

sentences.en: That we knew that wasn't going to satisfy their demands.
sentences.zh: 我们知道那不会满足他们的要求。

sentences.en: And that's not something I'm particularly proud of.
sentences.zh: 这不是我特别引以为豪的事情。

sentences.en: But it was just the realities we were facing.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我们面临的现实。

sentences.en: He says this part of the job kept him up at night.
sentences.zh: 他说这份工作的这一部分让他彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: He and his team at the agency even tried to come up with alternatives.
sentences.zh: 他和机构里的团队甚至尝试寻找替代方案。

sentences.en: But nothing ever really worked.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何办法真正奏效。

sentences.en: You know, it just, the American machine just swallowed him up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它只是，美国这台机器就这样吞噬了他。

sentences.en: And there was never any breathing room.
sentences.zh: 而且从来没有任何喘息的空间。

sentences.en: I mean, the margins are tiny in our system.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在我们的系统中，利润空间微乎其微。

sentences.en: After a few more years in this work, John left the field.
sentences.zh: 在这份工作又做了几年后，约翰离开了这个领域。

sentences.en: But it taught him something about America's refugee resettlement program.
sentences.zh: 但这让他了解了美国难民安置计划的一些情况。

sentences.en: The narrative that we're giving people these great opportunities,
sentences.zh: 我们给人们提供这些绝佳机会的叙事，

sentences.en: you know, like, there's a dark side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其实是有阴暗面的。

sentences.en: The system is supposed to get refugees out of danger.
sentences.zh: 这个系统本应让难民脱离危险。

sentences.en: But it then leaves them with little support.
sentences.zh: 但随后却让他们几乎得不到任何支持。

sentences.en: Many don't have language skills or a safety net.
sentences.zh: 许多人没有语言技能或安全网。

sentences.en: Compared to other immigrant groups, they're overrepresented in low-skilled work,
sentences.zh: 与其他移民群体相比，他们在低技能工作中占比过高，

sentences.en: they earn less, and are more likely to live in poverty.
sentences.zh: 收入更低，也更容易陷入贫困。

sentences.en: That's what makes them ideal recruits for meatpackers like JBS.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们成为像JBS这样的肉类加工商的理想招募对象。

sentences.en: With so few options, they take jobs most others won't.
sentences.zh: 由于选择太少，他们只能接受大多数人不愿意做的工作。

sentences.en: And even when the work leaves them injured, pushes them to work at impossible speeds,
sentences.zh: 即使工作让他们受伤，迫使他们以不可思议的速度工作，

sentences.en: or exposes them to religious discrimination,
sentences.zh: 或者让他们遭受宗教歧视，

sentences.en: many feel they have no choice but to stay.
sentences.zh: 许多人觉得除了留下别无选择。

sentences.en: We reached out to JBS for this story, but they declined to comment.
sentences.zh: 我们联系了JBS公司对此事进行采访，但他们拒绝置评。

sentences.en: Back in Mohammed's home, he tells me a bit about what it was like when he first came to Greeley.
sentences.zh: 回到穆罕默德的家中，他告诉我一些他刚到格里利时的感受。

sentences.en: It was a shock to leave behind the hot, tropical climate of Burma.
sentences.zh: 离开缅甸炎热的热带气候是一个巨大的冲击。

sentences.en: He remembers he saw snow here for the first time.
sentences.zh: 他记得他在这里第一次看到了雪。

sentences.en: What's something that Greeley doesn't have that you miss from your home country, Burma?
sentences.zh: 格里利有什么是你从家乡缅甸带来的，但这里却没有的吗？

sentences.en: He said Greeley didn't have the same variety of fruits and vegetables he was used to,
sentences.zh: 他说格里利没有他习惯的那种多样的水果和蔬菜，

sentences.en: so he started a garden in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 所以他在后院开辟了一个菜园。

sentences.en: How did he grow?
sentences.zh: 他种得怎么样？

sentences.en: When I met him, Mohammed had been off work for several weeks on disability with an injured hand.
sentences.zh: 我见到穆罕默德时，他因为手部受伤已经休残疾假好几周了。

sentences.en: He showed me how when he tried to make a fist, some of the fingers wouldn't bend.
sentences.zh: 他向我展示了当他试图握拳时，有些手指无法弯曲。

sentences.en: He had surgery a few years ago, but it still doesn't work like it used to.
sentences.zh: 几年前他做过手术，但现在还是不如以前灵活了。

sentences.en: Still, he tells me he's eager to get back to work.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他告诉我他很渴望回到工作中。

sentences.en: When we spoke, his immediate family, including his wife and five kids, were still displaced and living in India.
sentences.zh: 当我们交谈时，他的直系亲属，包括他的妻子和五个孩子，仍然流离失所，住在印度。

sentences.en: And he helps support about 20 members of his extended family as well.
sentences.zh: 而且他还帮助供养大约20名大家庭成员。

sentences.en: Yes, I want to go back as soon as possible because there's many kind of bills I have to pay.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想尽快回去，因为有很多账单要付。

sentences.en: So I can't go because I don't get doctor's approval yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能去，因为我还没有得到医生的批准。

sentences.en: With this influx of refugees, the city of Greeley was once again transformed.
sentences.zh: 随着难民的涌入，格里利市再次发生了转变。

sentences.en: In 2007, just one year after the ICE raids, the foreign-born population grew to about 13,000,
sentences.zh: 2007年，在移民及海关执法局（ICE）突袭行动一年后，外国出生人口增长到约13,000人，

sentences.en: a 76% increase from seven years earlier.
sentences.zh: 比七年前增加了76%。

sentences.en: In 2008, Greeley became an official refugee resettlement site.
sentences.zh: 2008年，格里利成为官方的难民安置点。

sentences.en: Now, instead of moving to Greeley from a nearby city, a person could be brought there directly from a refugee camp.
sentences.zh: 现在，一个人不再是从附近的城市搬到格里利，而是可以直接从难民营被带到那里。

sentences.en: And inevitably, they'd be recruited for a job at JBS.
sentences.zh: 不可避免地，他们会被招募去JBS工作。

sentences.en: It was a lot for a small city of 90,000.
sentences.zh: 对于一个9万人口的小城市来说，这负担很重。

sentences.en: And just like before, it wasn't always pretty.
sentences.zh: 和以前一样，过程并不总是那么美好。

sentences.en: A local mosque was shot at in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 当地一座清真寺在光天化日之下遭到枪击。

sentences.en: There was a small anti-Sharia law proteSt.
sentences.zh: 当时还有一场小规模的抗议活动，反对伊斯兰教法。

sentences.en: In the lens of history, that was not long after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 从历史的角度来看，那是在“9·11”事件后不久。

sentences.en: Here's James Horan again from the Refugee Resettlement Agency.
sentences.zh: 这是难民安置署的詹姆斯·霍兰（James Horan）。

sentences.en: And so I think there was a lot of focus on Islam.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为当时人们对伊斯兰教非常关注。

sentences.en: And what does it mean that now there is an Islamic community in my community?
sentences.zh: 而现在我的社区里有了伊斯兰群体，这意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: James spent a lot of time holding community meetings where people could come to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯花了很多时间召开社区会议，让人们有机会提问。

sentences.en: He remembers he had to dispel a lot of the same myths that persist today.
sentences.zh: 他记得自己当时不得不消除许多至今仍然存在的误解。

sentences.en: Another thing I would talk to people a lot about is the security clearances that refugees go through.
sentences.zh: 我经常和人们谈论的另一件事是难民必须通过的安全审查。

sentences.en: Because that was another question.
sentences.zh: 因为这也是当时的一个疑问。

sentences.en: Is this a public safety issue?
sentences.zh: 这是一个公共安全问题吗？

sentences.en: But with time, Greeley once again adjusted.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，格里利再次适应了。

sentences.en: Today, there's a strong network of support services like food pantries and driving courses.
sentences.zh: 如今，这里拥有强大的支持服务网络，比如食物救济站和驾驶课程。

sentences.en: There are free English classes and GED courses taught in the evenings at the local library.
sentences.zh: 当地图书馆在晚上提供免费的英语课程和高中同等学力（GED）课程。

sentences.en: The public schools have a successful ESL program.
sentences.zh: 公立学校也有非常成功的英语作为第二语言（ESL）项目。

sentences.en: And then there's the Immigrant and Refugee Center of Northern Colorado,
sentences.zh: 此外还有北科罗拉多移民与难民中心，

sentences.en: which helps refugees do everything from interpret their mail to apply for citizenship.
sentences.zh: 它帮助难民处理从解读信件到申请公民身份的各种事务。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm just helping him pay the bill.
sentences.zh: 是的，我只是在帮他付账单。

sentences.en: I think this is the toll bill that he needs help paying.
sentences.zh: 我想这是他需要帮助支付的过路费账单。

sentences.en: So this is like a regular stuff that we do here.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是我们在这里做的日常工作。

sentences.en: This is Kareem Abdul-Manaf, who works at the center.
sentences.zh: 这位是卡里姆·阿卜杜勒-马纳夫（Kareem Abdul-Manaf），他在中心工作。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样呢？

sentences.en: Just because it's all in English?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为全是英文吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sometimes it's all because it's all in English.
sentences.zh: 是的，有时完全是因为全是英文。

sentences.en: And other times, they don't know how to navigate all those websites and everything.
sentences.zh: 还有些时候，他们不知道如何浏览那些网站和处理各种事务。

sentences.en: So that's one of the reasons they come here.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他们来这里的原因之一。

sentences.en: Kareem arrived in Greeley about eight years ago.
sentences.zh: 卡里姆大约八年前来到格里利。

sentences.en: He and his family became refugees after facing persecution in their home country of Burma.
sentences.zh: 他和家人在缅甸家乡遭受迫害后成为了难民。

sentences.en: He speaks Rohingya and helps other Rohingya refugees translate things from English,
sentences.zh: 他会说罗兴亚语，并帮助其他罗兴亚难民翻译各种资料，

sentences.en: like their phone bills and bank statements.
sentences.zh: 比如他们的电话账单和银行对账单。

sentences.en: So you're kind of able to be the helping hand that you didn't really have.
sentences.zh: 所以你算是成为了你当初没能得到的那个援手。

sentences.en: Yes, and I'm glad that I can help the community to give them back.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很高兴能回馈社区，帮助他们。

sentences.en: Because I know how it feels to be lost in a new place.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道在一个陌生的地方感到迷茫是什么滋味。

sentences.en: Kareem worked at JBS for two years, and so did his four older brothers when they were first resettled in Greeley.
sentences.zh: 卡里姆在JBS工作了两年，他的四个哥哥刚搬到格里利时也都在那里工作。

sentences.en: It was and still is the primary job in the area that doesn't require English or any previous experience.
sentences.zh: 这过去是，现在依然是该地区不需要英语或任何工作经验的主要工作岗位。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say JBS is a long-term job, but for some of the families, they are planning to just do JBS for as long as they can.
sentences.zh: 我不会说JBS是一份长期工作，但对一些家庭来说，他们计划只要能做就一直做下去。

sentences.en: They have to do it because they have no other options here in Greeley.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不这样做，因为在格里利他们别无选择。

sentences.en: And recently, there's been yet another new wave of arrivals.
sentences.zh: 最近，又出现了一波新的移民潮。

sentences.en: The many thousands of Haitians and Venezuelans who came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的海地人和委内瑞拉人来到美国，

sentences.en: on temporary protected status.
sentences.zh: 持有临时保护身份（TPS）。

sentences.en: TPS allows people from certain countries to stay and work here if it's too dangerous to go back home.
sentences.zh: 如果回国太危险，TPS允许来自特定国家的人留在这里工作。

sentences.en: What community do you primarily work with?
sentences.zh: 你主要服务于哪个群体？

sentences.en: Haitian community.
sentences.zh: 海地群体。

sentences.en: This is Dree.
sentences.zh: 这位是德里（Dree）。

sentences.en: He originally came to Greeley from New Jersey because he heard about the work available at JBS.
sentences.zh: 他最初是从新泽西州来到格里利的，因为他听说JBS有工作机会。

sentences.en: But after a few weeks, he quit.
sentences.zh: 但几周后，他辞职了。

sentences.en: It was overwhelming, a lot of pressure, especially from the management staff.
sentences.zh: 那太让人难以承受了，压力很大，尤其是来自管理层。

sentences.en: They're trying to get stuff done, like, you know, Rico time.
sentences.zh: 他们总是想赶进度，比如，你知道的，为了赶工期。

sentences.en: So it's kind of challenging for your body and your mental.
sentences.zh: 所以这对你的身体和心理都是一种挑战。

sentences.en: Then he showed up at this refugee and immigration center with a friend and was quickly offered a job
sentences.zh: 后来他和一个朋友来到这个难民与移民中心，很快就得到了一份工作，

sentences.en: because he speaks English and Haitian Creole fluently.
sentences.zh: 因为他能流利地说英语和海地克里奥尔语。

sentences.en: Just like Karim, he helps Haitians navigate life in Greeley.
sentences.zh: 就像卡里姆一样，他帮助海地人适应格里利的生活。

sentences.en: But the day we met, things got a lot more complicated.
sentences.zh: 但我们见面的那天，情况变得复杂多了。

sentences.en: The Trump administration canceled temporary protected status for Venezuelans.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府取消了委内瑞拉人的临时保护身份。

sentences.en: Haitians with protected status would be next.
sentences.zh: 拥有保护身份的海地人可能就是下一个。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court just canceled the TPS for Venezuelans now.
sentences.zh: 最高法院刚刚取消了委内瑞拉人的TPS。

sentences.en: Like, we are talking about, like, 300,000 people.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的可是大约30万人。

sentences.en: And that just happened?
sentences.zh: 这刚发生的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Probably going to cancel for Haitians.
sentences.zh: 可能很快也会取消海地人的。

sentences.en: Do you think you'll get a lot of people in here today asking about that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得今天会有很多人来这里问这件事吗？

sentences.en: Um, the TPS, the fact that the new just came out, like, minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于TPS，这个消息是几分钟前才出来的。

sentences.en: For sure, next week, it's going to be, like, overwhelming for them.
sentences.zh: 下周肯定会让他们感到不知所措。

sentences.en: Like, to come here and ask a question, what can I do?
sentences.zh: 他们会来这里问，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: What can I do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: What will be the next step?
sentences.zh: 下一步该怎么做？

sentences.en: The refugee program as we know it, the one created in the 1980s, is on pause indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 我们所熟知的难民项目，那个始于20世纪80年代的项目，目前已无限期暂停。

sentences.en: The flow of people like Mohamed, Kareem, and Dree has all but stopped, which raises the same question the industry has faced for generations.
sentences.zh: 像穆罕默德、卡里姆和德里这样的人流几乎已经停止，这提出了该行业几代人以来一直面临的同一个问题。

sentences.en: Where will the workers come from?
sentences.zh: 工人从哪里来？

sentences.en: If I were the CEO of a big company like JBS, I might be wringing my hands right about now.
sentences.zh: 如果我是像JBS这样大公司的首席执行官，我现在可能已经焦头烂额了。

sentences.en: Of all U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国所有行业中，

sentences.en: industries, meatpacking has the fifth highest concentration of refugee workers.
sentences.zh: 肉类加工业的难民工人比例排名第五。

sentences.en: And more broadly, about 40% of meatpacking workers are foreign-born.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，约40%的肉类加工工人是外籍人士。

sentences.en: I think there's definitely an economic conversation to be had.
sentences.zh: 我认为绝对有必要进行一场关于经济的对话。

sentences.en: And I think employers will probably be the drivers of that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为雇主可能会是这场对话的推动者。

sentences.en: That's James Horan again.
sentences.zh: 这是詹姆斯·霍兰再次发言。

sentences.en: It's just going to be a math issue, right?
sentences.zh: 这终究是个数学问题，对吧？

sentences.en: I think when you're an employer and you have a workforce need and you have a certain number of jobs open
sentences.zh: 我认为当你作为雇主，有劳动力需求，并且有一定数量的职位空缺时，

sentences.en: and you don't have people to draw on to fill those jobs, you are limited.
sentences.zh: 而你又没有足够的人手来填补这些职位，你就会受到限制。

sentences.en: As a country, we're once again in a fiercely anti-immigrant climate.
sentences.zh: 作为一个国家，我们再次处于一种强烈的反移民氛围中。

sentences.en: And while every country needs a fair immigration system, we can't deny that the populations we're targeting play an essential role in our economy.
sentences.zh: 虽然每个国家都需要一个公平的移民制度，但我们不能否认，我们针对的这些群体在我们的经济中发挥着至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: They don't just fill jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅仅是填补了职位空缺。

sentences.en: They fill hard, dangerous jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们填补的是那些艰苦、危险的职位。

sentences.en: The ones that most people will avoid if they have the choice.
sentences.zh: 如果有的选，大多数人都会避开这些工作。

sentences.en: When people are deported in droves, it leaves a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 当人们被大规模驱逐出境时，就会留下真空。

sentences.en: When refugees aren't allowed to come, it leaves a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 当难民不被允许入境时，也会留下真空。

sentences.en: And when there's no one left to slaughter our cows, we're reminded of a truth Upton Sinclair tried to tell us in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 当没有人来屠宰我们的牛时，我们就会想起厄普顿·辛克莱（Upton Sinclair）在《屠场》（The Jungle）中试图告诉我们的真相。

sentences.en: This country depends on vulnerable people to do its dirtiest, most grueling work.
sentences.zh: 这个国家依赖弱势群体来从事最肮脏、最繁重的工作。

sentences.en: We've just never wanted to see it.
sentences.zh: 只是我们一直不愿正视这一点。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was reported this week by Esther Honig and was produced and edited by Delaney Hall,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由埃丝特·霍尼格（Esther Honig）报道，德莱尼·霍尔（Delaney Hall）制作和剪辑，

sentences.zh: 本报道与食品与环境报道网络（FERN）合作完成，

sentences.zh: 并获得了加州大学伯克利分校第11小时食品与农业奖学金的资助。

sentences.zh: 我们是SiriusXM播客家族的一员，总部现位于北边六个街区外的潘多拉大厦（Pandora Building），

sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的住宅区。

sentences.zh: 你可以在所有常见的社交媒体网站以及我们自己的Discord服务器上找到我们。
